verdicts.reason: Both pull the quote out of the frame, which exposes a stock 'BEAUTY ILLUSTRATION / HAND DRAWN ELEMENTS' placeholder inside the shrunken frame. The design's core idea, the quote framed by the illustration, is lost. A at least gives the quote a large, clear headline size, but CAROLYN MURPHY floats off to the right, vertically centred beside the quote and wrapped onto two lines. That makes the bottom lopsided under a small, centred illustration. B is a timid shrunk column with huge dead margins and an empty bottom third. Its attribution is almost the size of the quote and jammed against it with no gap. A stray faint rule sits above the text, and there is no real hierarchy.
